hero.title: Energy at the heart of everyday uses
hero.description: An African energy group, ZENER develops fuel, gas, mobility and service solutions to provide lasting support to individuals, businesses and institutions.

company.subtitle: Zener in a few words
company.title: Energy expertise rooted in Togo, with a regional ambition
company.p1: ZENER is a major player in Togo's energy sector, present across the entire value chain through fuel and gas distribution, lubricants, mobility services and energy solutions for individuals, professionals, businesses and institutions. Over the years, ZENER has built infrastructure, a distribution network, strong brands and an ecosystem of services that allow it to respond to changing energy uses and needs.
company.p2: Building on its historic roots in Togo, ZENER is pursuing regional growth with a presence in Benin and Guinea-Bissau. This expansion reflects an ambition: to grow an African energy model founded on operational expertise, closeness to markets and innovation. Today, ZENER continues its transformation, combining operational performance, quality of service and the development of new solutions for energy that is more accessible and closer to everyday uses.

vision.title: Becoming a leading partner in West and Central Africa
vision.p1: ZENER aims to become a reference energy partner in West and Central Africa by developing solutions tailored to the realities of local markets and evolving needs.
vision.p2: Its strategy is built on consolidating its historical business lines, developing new energy and mobility solutions, driving innovation in services and progressively strengthening its regional presence. This ambition is rooted in a responsible growth approach, based on operational excellence, quality of service and the ability to sustainably meet the needs of territories, businesses and communities.

governance.title: Governance
governance.p1: ZENER's governance rests on decision-making and oversight bodies that set strategic direction, monitor activities and safeguard the company's performance.
governance.p2: It is built on a structured organization, a clear allocation of responsibilities and a culture of accountability at every level. This governance supports ZENER's ambitions, underpins operational excellence and helps ensure the Group's long-term development.

presence.title: Geographic presence
presence.p1: ZENER operates in Togo, Benin and Guinea-Bissau, with teams and activities closely attuned to the realities of each market.
presence.p2: Building on its strong footing in West Africa, ZENER continues its regional expansion with the ambition of strengthening its presence and progressively deploying its expertise in new markets.

careers.title: Grow your potential at Zener
careers.text: ZENER is built by committed women and men who contribute every day to transforming the energy and mobility sectors in West Africa. The Group values responsibility, initiative and skills development, within an environment that fosters learning and collaboration. ZENER offers career growth opportunities across a wide range of operational, technical, commercial and digital roles. Joining ZENER means being part of a growing, meaningful project geared toward the future.

subsidiaries.title: Local execution, a group vision
subsidiaries.intro: ZENER carries out its activities through specialized subsidiaries and entities, organized by market and area of expertise. The Group relies in particular on ZenGrupo (Guinea-Bissau), Zener Togo (Togo), Zener Benin (Benin), PLS (propane storage and distribution) and PGS (energy solutions).
subsidiaries.metiersIntro: ZENER runs complementary businesses serving energy, mobility and related uses. This organization allows the Group to effectively meet the needs of individuals, businesses and institutions.

maritime.title: Marine bunkering & aviation
maritime.text: ZENER delivers fuel to ships (bunkering), relying on controlled operations that meet safety and supply-continuity requirements, with an ambition in aviation.

fuel.title: Fuel distribution
fuel.text: ZENER distributes fuel through a structured network of stations and infrastructure meeting international safety and quality standards.

gas.title: Gas / energy
gas.text: ZENER develops safe and accessible gas and household energy solutions, tailored to the needs of households and local businesses, with its Sodigaz and Enora brands.

cards.title: ZenCard
cards.subtitle: Card and payment to secure, track and manage energy use
cards.text: ZenCard equips fleets, sites and partners with a payment method dedicated to energy. Consumption is tracked, limits are configurable and teams manage usage in real time.

lubricants.title: Lubricants
lubricants.text: ZENER offers a range of lubricants and accessories selected to ensure the performance, durability and protection of equipment.

business.title: Business / SME
business.text: Dedicated solutions for businesses to secure operations, control costs and optimize energy use.

horeca.title: HORECA
horeca.text: ZENER supports hotels, restaurants, cafés and service businesses with reliable energy solutions adapted to their operating constraints.

partners.title: Partners & institutions
partners.text: ZENER works with public institutions, technical and financial partners and key organizations.

digital.title: Managing energy use
digital.p1: ZENER uses innovation and digital technology as key drivers of performance, transparency and experience.
digital.p2: Platforms and initiatives: ZenCard, ZenFamili, Zenaya, Security & data, Innovation & pilot projects.

zencard.title: ZenCard
zencard.text: A dedicated card and payment solution to secure, track and manage energy use.

zenfamili.title: ZenFamili
zenfamili.text: A digital loyalty and customer experience ecosystem, designed to strengthen relationships, engagement and continuity of use.

security.title: Security & data
security.text: A rigorous approach to operational security and data management, supporting reliability, compliance and trust.

zenmobility.title: Zenaya
zenmobility.text: A support and customer relations service combining digital tools and human assistance for a more responsive and accessible service.

rse.title: People, safety and the environment
rse.p1: Aware of its role and impact as a responsible corporate citizen, ZENER fully integrates Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) into its overall strategy. Our ambition is to continue growing in energy and digital innovation while putting people, safety and the environment at the heart of our actions.
rse.p2: Governance and ethics: rigorous standards of ethics, transparency and compliance, for a safe, dynamic and responsible company. Raising awareness for greater safety: a safety awareness program on the use of LPG and fuel, to promote good practices and reduce risks.
rse.p3: Improving living conditions: social projects, community actions and local initiatives to support people and community well-being. Protecting the environment: solutions and practices designed to limit emissions, reduce waste and support a sustainable energy transition.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Developing fuel, gas, mobility and service solutions to provide lasting support to individuals, businesses and institutions.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: Becoming a leading energy partner in West and Central Africa.

cta.title: Contact our teams
cta.text: Let's talk about your energy, mobility or partnership needs.
